name: Paulo Do Nascimento Cabral-Draft Council decision
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees to a new five-year fishing deal between the EU and Cabo Verde. EU boats may catch 7,000 tonnes of tuna and similar fish in Cabo Verde's waters each year. In return, the EU pays Cabo Verde 780,000 euros a year: 350,000 for access to the fish and 430,000 to help develop the country's own fishing industry. The deal also covers better monitoring of boats, protection of sharks and the marine environment, and action against illegal fishing.

- EU boats get access to catch 7,000 tonnes of tuna a year in Cabo Verde's waters for five years.
- Cabo Verde receives 780,000 euros a year, with 430,000 going to its fishing sector.
- Parliament has approved the deal, so the Council can now formally conclude it.
